scripts.build:proto: mkdir -p src/proto && npx pbjs -t static-module -w es6 -o src/proto/ast.js starkom/proto/ast.proto && npx pbts -o src/proto/ast.d.ts src/proto/ast.js
scripts.build:wasm: (cd starkom && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown) && wasm-bindgen starkom/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/starkom.wasm --out-dir bindings/ --target bundler
scripts.build:ts: npx tsc && mkdir -p dist/proto && cp src/proto/* dist/proto/ && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.build: npm run build:proto && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
